title: Apex Autopilot Optimization — Unified Macro Architecture
description: Unified framework for UAV/UAS and ground vehicle autopilot optimization, synthesizing 100 research agents across 1000+ queries.

nodes.label: Core Layer
nodes.description: Types, interfaces, configuration, and utilities shared across all modules

nodes.label: Perception Layer
nodes.description: Sensor fusion, SLAM, and perception pipelines for environment understanding

nodes.label: Estimation Layer

nodes.label: Planning Layer
nodes.description: A*, RRT, PRM, and Hybrid A* path planning algorithms

nodes.label: Optimization Layer
nodes.description: Minimum snap, MPC, convex optimization, and GCS trajectory optimization

nodes.label: Swarm Layer
nodes.description: Task allocation, formation control, coverage control, and search coordination

nodes.label: Control Layer
nodes.description: PID, LQR, MPC, sliding mode, and adaptive control algorithms

nodes.label: Safety Layer

nodes.label: Interface Layer
